name: PURGATORY: BLUE
original_name: パーガトリー・ブルー
source:
An unknown energy “kinetic aura (KA)” was identified in Tokyo Bay. Through its technological diversion, modern Japan has grown overnight into an energy superpower.
　The protagonist, [url=/c156929]Aima Akito[/url], participates in a long-sought internship at Rimbo, a next-generation smart city built on the sea. As his new life begins, he is excited by the stimulating environment.
　Akito is surrounded by unique people. There is [url=/c147336]Sayuuda Haruna[/url], a crazy senior girl with whom he has a rotten relationship, and an employee who is presumably a good tease and a dominant older sister. Akito feels a sense of fulfillment as he spends his days at the center of cutting-edge technology, being pushed around and squeezed, but also feeling a sense of not being satisfied.
　One day, however, Akito has a chance meeting with his estranged childhood friend, [url=/c147334]Yumeoka Anne[/url]. She is a highly popular member of an international idol group, but she is currently suspended due to certain suspicions.
　Even stranger, Anne's appearance is unrecognizable to others and only Akito seems to be able to see her......? 

[Translated from the [url=https://purgatory-blue.tokyo/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
在东京湾发现了未知能量“动能光环（KA）”。通过技术转移，现代日本一夜之间成长为能源超级大国。
　主角 [url=/c156929]Aima Akito[/url] 参加了期待已久的Rimbo实习，Rimbo是一座建立在海上的下一代智能城市。当他的新生活开始时，他对充满刺激的环境感到兴奋。
　明人周围都是独特的人。其中有[url=/c147336]Sayuuda Haruna[/url]，一个与他有着糟糕关系的疯狂高级女孩，以及一个可能是一个很好的挑逗者和一个占主导地位的姐姐的员工。明人在尖端技术的中心度过每一天，被人摆布、被挤压，心里有一种成就感，但也有一种不满足的感觉。
　然而有一天，明人有机会见到了他疏远的儿时好友，[url=/c147334]梦冈安妮[/url]。她是国际偶像团体中人气很高的成员，但目前因某些嫌疑而被停职。
　更奇怪的是，安妮的容貌别人都认不出来，似乎只有明人才能看到她……？

[翻译自[url=https://purgatory-blue.tokyo/#story]官网[/url]]
